after.description: [Mozio] - The Promo code amount is NOT displayed as expected for Return trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation. For return trip Mozio reservations that have a promo code applied, the discount amount is missing from the email confirmation, whereas it appears correctly for one-way trips.
after.title: [Mozio] - Promo code amount not displayed for Return trip tickets in Mozio email confirmation

notes: Defect: promo code amount missing from Mozio email confirmation for return trip tickets. The discount data exists in the dispatch report (map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch.ts maps it optionally) but is likely not being populated for return trip dispatches during reservation creation/submission. The apply-report-discounts.service.ts and create-reservations.mappers.ts are the probable root cause — return trip dispatches may not receive discount report data.

notes: Openspec provided empty acceptance criteria, so I built the full set from the story context. AC-1 and AC-2 are the core fix and regression guard. AC-3 covers the no-promo edge case. AC-4 ensures the displayed amount is correct (not just present). AC-5 addresses the probable root cause at the reservation creation level — that return trip dispatches must receive discount data. AC-6 covers the zero-value promo edge case. AC-7 targets the mapper layer (map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch.ts) to ensure discount fields flow through for return trips, not just outbound.
